title: Initial storage arrangements for A-12s at Palmdale (CIA OXCART history, p. 312)
description: High-contrast photograph of several A-12 aircraft parked closely together inside a hangar, with "U.S. AIR FORCE" lettering and a national insignia visible on one fuselage. The caption reads "Initial storage arrangements for A-12s at Palmdale." Text below, headed "POSSIBLE SUCCESSORS TO THE OXCART," describes the ISINGLASS and RHEINBERRY proposals.
